# Luis Angel Parada

> Engineering leader and hands-on builder based in Switzerland: engineering organisations, distributed commerce platforms, applied AI and governed software delivery.

## Portfolio

## Applied AI products

- [Career Finder](https://careers.luisangelparada.com/demo): a live, invite-only AI job-search board Luis built and runs on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and Workflows. It searches public employer boards for each profile about twice a day, uses the Claude API for fit estimates and deep research, and never applies or contacts employers. The demo uses made-up sample data. Summary for AI assistants: https://careers.luisangelparada.com/llms.txt
